notes.title: Update "Patch v.0.2.1"
notes.content:
Hello World. 
[b]UPDATE:[/b] We have reverted back to v.0.2.1 (previous version) due to reports of unstable performance. We are investigating and will update to v.0.2.2 once we believe any performance issues have been resolved.

In the update of [h1]26/07/2018[/h1]
[i]- Fixed getting stuck in Ancient Forest Trees when crouching up against them.[/i]
[i]- Changed some scenes.[/i]
[i]- Added new objects.[/i]
[i]- Fixed swimming under the map in places.[/i]
[i]- Price reduction in Steam.[/i]

notes.title: Update "Patch v.0.1.1"
notes.content:
[b][h1]23 April, 2018. Update game "TOF".[/h1][/b]

We watched the behavior of players, curators, bloggers. How they played and left their feedback. For us this is very important, since the project is in early access. There was a lot of negativity, but generally positive reviews.

[b]First update![/b]
[h1]Fixed:[/h1] 
- [i]changed the schedule for Direct X11.[/i]
- [i]trails.[/i]
- [i]Physics, the behavior of objects in the scenes.[/i]
- [i]Buildings.[/i]
[i]Changed the landscape of the scenes. Added new objects.[/i]

[h1]The following updates will be added:[/h1]
[i]Enemies, weapons, inventory.[/i]
[i]New menu, interface, sounds.[/i]
[i]New missions, riddles, artifacts.[/i]

[h1]Thank you, for reviewing the soundtrack![/h1]

Curators and bloggers I would like to say. That we are a young team "Modii Games". And we try, we listen, and listen to your comments! You judge wrong (negative), for example, put the steep and successful projects like "Skyrim". Do not be strictly judged!

See you!
The team, Modii Games.
